content.what_it_is: Small interactive MATLAB check script for the beach_2d case: animates a 1-D transect (row 50) of surface elevation against depth for output files 10-90. Loads dep.out @L5; for each nfile in [10:90] (L4, L7): loads eta_/etasrn_/mask_ files (L11-L13), plots eta(50,:) blue @L15, etasrn(50,:) cyan dashed @L17, -dep(50,:) black dashed @L18, then sets eta(mask>0)=NaN @L19 and overplots the remaining (masked-cell) values as red circles @L20; zoomed axis [200 250 -0.5 1] @L21; pause between frames @L23.
entities: script; clear all @L1; variables: fdir @L2; nfile @L4; dep @L5; num @L7; fnum @L10; eta @L11; etasrn @L12; mask @L13

equations.ref: inverted masking: NaNs out WET cells (mask>0) so the red-circle overplot @L20 shows only dry/masked cells

calls: builtins: load, sprintf, clf, plot, hold, axis, grid, pause
unresolved: Mask condition @L19 is inverted relative to the other beach_2d scripts (which NaN mask==0): here wet cells are NaNed so the red circles @L20 mark dry cells — intent (testing wet/dry front on screen) is implied by the file name but not documented
etasrn_ output field ('screen' eta?) is loaded @L12 — its producer/meaning is outside this file; x-axis is column index (no dx scaling), window 200-250 columns
